from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentCase(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document for classification."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document")
    case_nature: str = Field(description="The general nature of the case as stated in the document (e.g., '民事', '刑事', '行政')")
    cause_of_action_label: str = Field(description="The specific cause of action or charge found in the document (e.g., '产品责任纠纷', '渎职罪')")
    is_administrative_execution: bool = Field(description="True if the document involves administrative execution proceedings")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates the extracted facts for all documents in the collection."""
    judgments: list[JudgmentCase]
